# Far hills (parallax). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Hill --base-color 0.188 0.376 0.510 --no-slot
material new HillTop --base-color 0.216 0.580 0.431 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --segments 10 --rings 6 --radius 0.5 --name H0 --location -12.10 0 0
scale 4.97 1.0 3.41
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Hill
active H0
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.0 || normal.y > 0.3"
delete only-faces
select face where "pos.z > 1.23"
material assign HillTop
mode object
add mesh uv-sphere --segments 10 --rings 6 --radius 0.5 --name H1 --location -8.10 0 0
scale 4.81 1.0 3.33
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Hill
active H1
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.0 || normal.y > 0.3"
delete only-faces
select face where "pos.z > 1.20"
material assign HillTop
mode object
